subject: Payment page just spins
body: I filled in my card details and hit the button and the page has been spinning for about five minutes now. Nothing happens. I tried twice more and it did the same thing both times.

subject: Cannot finish my order
body: The little wheel just keeps turning when I try to pay. My basket still has everything in it but I cannot get past the last step.

subject: Is the site broken?
body: Tried to buy something three times. Each time it sits there for ages and then tells me to try again later. Is something going on?

subject: Bulk order submission not going through
body: Our procurement team has been unable to submit our scheduled weekly bulk order since about 2:35pm. The confirmation step never returns. This needs to be placed before end of day or it rolls into next week's cycle. Please advise urgently.

contract.notes: Platinum contract requires customer notification within 30 minutes of a confirmed degradation affecting order submission.

subject: Order button does nothing
body: I press place order and it just hangs. Waited a really long time. Gave up and closed the tab.

subject: public complaint
body: anyone else unable to buy anything on here right now? been stuck on the paying screen for ten minutes

subject: How do I change my delivery address?
body: I need to update the address on an order I placed yesterday. Where do I do that?

subject: Compliment for the team
body: Just wanted to say the new dark mode looks fantastic on mobile. Much easier on the eyes at night.
